normalized.title: Aging Is a Disease. Is There a Cure?
normalized.summary: CAMBRIDGE (Jun 12, 2015) -- Nobody lives forever, but a new approach to understanding human evolution suggests we are living shorter life spans than we could, and that aging should be thought of as a treatable disease, rather than a byproduct of time.
